tagline: Find your way from day one
welcomeMessage: Welcome aboard! Tap any zone on the map to learn what happens there, who to contact, and what safety gear you need.

zones.name: Main Inventory Section
zones.description: Central warehouse for raw materials and finished goods. Safety shoes mandatory.
zones.details:
• Capacity: 12,000 pallets
• Contact: inventory@lankatyre.example
• Open 24/7 — three shifts
• Forklift charging bays along the west wall
zones.safetyNotes: Wear a high-visibility vest and safety shoes. Forklift traffic is active at all times — stay inside the green pedestrian lanes.

si.name: ප්‍රධාන තොග අංශය
si.description: අමුද්‍රව්‍ය සහ නිමි භාණ්ඩ සඳහා මධ්‍යම ගබඩාව. ආරක්ෂිත සපත්තු අනිවාර්යයි.

zones.name: Bamburio Assembly Zone
zones.description: Specialized Bamburio product line assembly — our flagship radial tyre series.
zones.details:
• Line speed: 380 units / shift
• Team lead: K. Perera (ext. 214)
• Tooling stored in cage B-4
• Kaizen board at the north entrance
zones.safetyNotes: Hearing protection required. Keep clear of the yellow robot envelope markings.

zones.name: Quality Control Lab
zones.description: Inspection, testing and certification of every production batch.
zones.details:
• Batch sampling every 2 hours
• Contact: qc@lankatyre.example
• ISO 9001 documentation kept here
zones.safetyNotes: Lab coats and safety glasses required beyond the blue line.

zones.name: Shipping & Dispatch Dock
zones.description: Outbound goods staging, container loading and courier pickup.
zones.details:
• Dock doors: 6 (D1–D6)
• Cut-off for same-day dispatch: 15:30
• Contact: dispatch@lankatyre.example
zones.safetyNotes: Dock edges are fall hazards. Never stand behind a reversing truck — use the banksman.

zones.name: Staff Canteen
zones.description: Meals, tea breaks and the best string hoppers in the industrial zone.
zones.details:
• Breakfast: 06:30 – 08:00
• Lunch: 11:30 – 13:30
• Tea: 15:00 – 15:30
• Vegetarian options daily

si.name: කාර්ය මණ්ඩල ආපනශාලාව
si.description: ආහාර වේල්, තේ විවේක සහ කලාපයේ හොඳම ඉඳිආප්ප.

zones.name: First Aid & Medical Room
zones.description: First aid station with a trained medic on every shift.
zones.details:
• Emergency internal line: 999
• AED mounted outside the door
• Eye-wash station inside
zones.safetyNotes: In an emergency call 999 from any internal phone, then send a runner here.

si.name: ප්‍රථමාධාර සහ වෛද්‍ය කාමරය
si.description: සෑම වැඩමුරයකම පුහුණු වෛද්‍ය සහායකයෙකු සිටින ප්‍රථමාධාර මධ්‍යස්ථානය.

zones.name: Main Entrance & Reception
zones.description: Security check-in, visitor badges and the QR onboarding point.
zones.details:
• All visitors must sign in here
• Lockers available for personal items
• Scan the wall QR to reopen this map anytime

si.name: ප්‍රධාන පිවිසුම සහ පිළිගැනීම
si.description: ආරක්ෂක ලියාපදිංචිය, අමුත්තන්ගේ බැජ් සහ QR ආරම්භක ස්ථානය.

zones.name: Stairwell A
zones.description: Main stairwell connecting the ground and first floors.

zones.name: Calendar & Production Planning
zones.description: Daily production schedule board and planning office.
zones.details:
• Current shift: Morning A
• Today's target: 4,200 units
• Planning stand-up at 08:15 daily

zones.name: Admin Offices
zones.description: HR, finance and general administration. New-hire paperwork happens here.
zones.details:
• HR desk hours: 08:00 – 17:00
• Contact: hr@lankatyre.example
• Bring your NIC for onboarding

zones.name: Meeting Rooms
zones.description: Bookable meeting rooms M1–M4 and the town-hall space.
zones.details:
• Book via reception or the wall tablets
• M4 has video conferencing

zones.name: R&D Laboratory
zones.description: Compound research, prototyping and materials testing.
zones.details:
• Restricted access — escort required
• Contact: rnd@lankatyre.example
zones.safetyNotes: Authorized personnel only. Chemical storage inside — no food or drink.

zones.name: Stairwell A
zones.description: Main stairwell connecting the first and ground floors.

zones.name: Raw Materials Storage
zones.description: Bulk rubber, steel cord and chemical compound storage.
zones.details:
• FIFO rotation enforced
• Temperature-controlled bays R1–R3
• Contact: rawstore@lankatyre.example
zones.safetyNotes: High-stacked racking — hard hats mandatory in all aisles.

zones.name: Packaging Line
zones.description: Final wrapping, labelling and palletising before dispatch.
zones.details:
• Two automated wrap lines
• Label printers in bay P2
zones.safetyNotes: Keep hands clear of the stretch-wrap turntable while it is in motion.
